subject: Staffing & constraints — infinite-width uncertainty
body: Ximena — staffing and constraints for the plan above. Committed for the window: Halima 80% (ESS + JAX), Wanjiru 40% (infra for kernel loading), Bilal 30% (Colab packaging), Paloma 20% (plots and report). Carmen is wrapping another push through spring, but for the H2 extension — Gaussian process classification with ESS on the larger kernel grids — Carmen Reyes is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026; I've put that in the resourcing sheet already. Compute is modest: the sampling runs are embarrassingly parallel and titan-a100 best-effort covers it; no vulcan or cirrus ask. The one platform dependency is storage — the precomputed Myrtle-10 kernels are large, and I'd rather mirror them once than have five people re-downloading. Halima will file the quota request this week. — Deshawn
